_doc: Last commit each corpus sweep covered. Written by the sweep itself, in the same commit as its audit doc — never as a separate step. `git log <watermark>..HEAD` is that sweep's delta. See .claude/skills/staleness-sweep/SKILL.md.

_full_run_triggers.staleness: board restructured, or a recalibration landed AND IS ENABLED BY DEFAULT (see journal/0111 + the qualifier in staleness-sweep/SKILL.md — an off-by-default recalibration voids nothing), or watermark older than ~5 active days
_full_run_triggers.spine-audit: any edit to docs/spines.md — every prior verdict was made against a different rule
_full_run_triggers.doc-topology: no reference side; incremental = changed docs read in full, then their NOUNS drive the search across everything else

_baseline.coverage: 100% of the 62,264-line corpus — 9 parallel opus readers, ~3,900 lines of audit in docs/audits/baseline-2026-07-28/
_baseline.note: First full-corpus baseline. Before it, doc-topology had covered ~9% in one run and spine-audit had left no artifacts at all. The staleness watermark is set because S5+S6 read all of ROADMAP Sequenced and Observed against newer work; doc-topology is set because S1-S4+S7-S9 covered the rest. spine-audit stayed null ON PURPOSE — this baseline was docs-vs-docs and never checked spines.md against the CODE, which is the one question spine-audit answers. RESOLVED 2026-07-29: spine-audit ran its own full pass at 96ab14b (docs/spines.md header) and set its watermark; the null is no longer outstanding. SUPERSEDED THE SAME DAY: a second FULL pass ran at 72fbe86 because spines.md itself changed in ten commits (the _full_run_triggers rule for this key), and it left the corpus's first spine-audit ARTIFACT — docs/audits/2026-07-29-spine-audit-full.md. The 'left no artifacts at all' clause above is now a statement about everything before that file.
_baseline.findings: ~80 pairs. Applied at baseline: the integrator's own same-day stalenesses + the ARCHITECTURE.md ON-HOLD banner. The remainder is filed as a ROADMAP entry, ranked, with the audits as the record.
